notes.title: Ninja Party: What’s Next — New Mode, iOS Release & Bug Fixes | NinJournal #1
notes.notes:
[p][i]Welcome to #NinJournal — our new dev log where we share future plans and behind-the-scenes stories.[/i] 
[/p][p]Today, our producer is here to tell you what’s coming in the next updates, ninja-bro![/p][p][/p][p][b]TL;DR for the laziest ninjas:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Bug fixes — we’re aware of the matchmaking and performance issues and are actively working on them.  [/p][/*][*][p]New “Blitz” mode — ultra-fast matches with no boring downtime between rounds.  [/p][/*][*][p]iOS version — polishing the build, launching alongside Blitz mode.  [/p][/*][*][p]Progression — leveling up will be easier, and rewards will come faster. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Read the full post here:[/b][/p][p][url="https://ninjaparty.com/news/ninjournal-1-whats-next-new-mode-ios-release-bug-fixes/"]https://ninjaparty.com/news/ninjournal-1-whats-next-new-mode-ios-release-bug-fixes/[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]And tell us in the comments what you think about Blitz!
